description: This file defines the 'UnivariateFunction' interface in the Apache Commons Math library, representing a univariate real function with a method to evaluate its value at a given point. It also provides example code illustrating how to handle exceptions within user-defined functions.

classes.name: UnivariateFunction
classes.description: Interface representing a univariate real function with a method to evaluate its value at a double input.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Computes the value of the univariate function at the specified point `x`. Throws IllegalArgumentException if preconditions are violated.
